query:
WITH years AS (
  SELECT 2021 AS year UNION ALL
  SELECT 2022 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2023 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2024 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2025
),
active_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    y.year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) AS active_employees
  FROM years y
  LEFT JOIN estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j 
    ON YEAR(j.job_start_date) <= y.year 
    AND (j.job_end_date IS NULL OR YEAR(j.job_end_date) >= y.year)
    AND j.is_active_job = 1
  GROUP BY y.year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  active_employees,
  LAG(active_employees) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_count,
  ROUND(
    CASE 
      WHEN LAG(active_employees) OVER (ORDER BY year) > 0 
      THEN ((active_employees - LAG(active_employees) OVER (ORDER BY year)) / LAG(active_employees) OVER (ORDER BY year)) * 100 
      ELSE NULL 
    END, 2
  ) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM active_counts
ORDER BY year LIMIT 1200
